name: Konuma Kiriko
source: Kiriko is a hostess of the "Naruto" inn. [url=https://vndb.org/c12870]Hiroshi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c3129]Oujo[/url] are staying at her inn. She is always making sure that her guests are feeling like at home when they are staying in her inn. She is a very kind, funny and... forgetful woman.
